about: [O2] after the critic (B6, the user's must): V in the car - the view behind it (the spring on its heading and place, high over the roof, the car whole: no hands, no cockpit), the turn's lag, reverse looks back, the look swings it round and it settles, RMB the seat while held, out and in again remembered, V back to the seat; the camera never through a wall and never cut. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o2_view.json

steps.eval: (() => { const R = window.__o2view = { n: 0, through: 0, minD: 99, maxJump: 0, last: null }; const g = G.stage.part('city').graph; const tick = () => { const C = G.city; if (C && C.inCar && C.chase && C.chase.k > 0.99) { const c = C.car.pos, p = G.camera.position; R.n++; if (!g.lineOfSight(c.x, c.z, p.x, p.z)) R.through++; R.minD = Math.min(R.minD, Math.hypot(p.x - c.x, p.z - c.z)); } const p = G.camera.position; if (R.last) { const j = Math.hypot(p.x - R.last.x, p.y - R.last.y, p.z - R.last.z); if (j > R.maxJump) { R.maxJump = j; R.at = { t: +G.time.toFixed(2), inCar: !!(C && C.inCar), k: C && C.chase ? +C.chase.k.toFixed(2) : null, mode: N.controller.mode, v: C && C.car ? +C.car.speed.toFixed(1) : null }; } } R.last = p.clone(); }; G.scripts.push(tick); return 'rec'; })()

steps.expect: G.city.chase.want && G.city.chase.k === 1 && !G.vm.visible && Math.hypot(G.camera.position.x - G.city.car.pos.x, G.camera.position.z - G.city.car.pos.z) > 4.5 && G.camera.position.y > 2.4 && G.save.flags.carView === 'third'
steps.label: V: behind the car, high over its roof, the hands and the cockpit gone, remembered
the man is still in the seat (G.eye: what sees him, shoots at him)

steps.eval: (() => { const c = G.city.car, p = G.camera.position; const a = Math.atan2(-(c.pos.z - p.z), c.pos.x - p.x); return { lag: +Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(a - c.yaw), Math.cos(a - c.yaw))).toFixed(3) }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const c = G.city.car, p = G.camera.position; const a = Math.atan2(-(c.pos.z - p.z), c.pos.x - p.x); return Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(a - c.yaw), Math.cos(a - c.yaw))) > 0.04; })()
steps.label: into the turn the view lags the car (the spring)
reverse: it looks back the way the car goes
the look swings it round the car
and it settles behind once the look rests
out of the car from the view behind: on foot

steps.look: (() => { const C = N.controller, c = G.city.car; const want = Math.atan2(-(c.pos.x - C.pos.x), -(c.pos.z - C.pos.z)); const err = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - C.yaw), Math.cos(want - C.yaw)); return [Math.round(-err / C.sensitivity), 0]; })()

steps.eval: ({ ...window.__o2view, last: null, pulled: G.city.chase.stats.pulled, toggles: G.city.chase.stats.toggles })

steps.label: never through a wall (the car to the camera clear every frame), never a cut (the camera's step under 2.6 m, the get out and in included)
